int_name: STENTON AVE & E WILLOW GROVE AVE

result.summary: The image shows a wide, signalized intersection in a residential area with faded crosswalk markings and no visible pedestrian signals. The large crossing distance and lack of refuge islands increase pedestrian exposure to vehicle traffic in an environment that prioritizes motor vehicle throughput.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalks
hazards.description: The painted crosswalk markings are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the foreground and side street

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway requires pedestrians to spend a significant amount of time in the conflict zone without a refuge.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the intersection

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Cracked and patched asphalt can create uneven surfaces for pedestrians and affect vehicle braking.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground roadway surface

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Repaint crosswalks using continental or ladder patterns to improve visibility for drivers.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve sight lines between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signals with countdown timers to provide clear crossing information.

result.summary: The intersection features a marked continental crosswalk and a small concrete refuge island, but lacks visible pedestrian signals. The wide roadway and multiple travel lanes increase pedestrian exposure to vehicle traffic in a residential setting.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic, increasing exposure time to vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No visible pedestrian-specific signals to indicate safe crossing intervals at a signalized intersection.
hazards.location_in_image: Intersection corners

hazards.name: Pavement Degradation
hazards.description: Cracking and wear in the asphalt near the crosswalk area could present a trip hazard.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground roadway surface

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing information and improve safety.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Signage
interventions.description: Add pedestrian crossing warning signs to alert drivers to the presence of the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Refuge Island Extension
interventions.description: Expand the existing refuge island to provide a more substantial protected space for pedestrians mid-crossing.

result.summary: The intersection lacks basic pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks and pedestrian signals despite being controlled by traffic lights. The wide roadway and absence of designated crossing areas create a hostile environment for pedestrians in a residential area.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crosswalks
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at this signalized intersection, leaving pedestrians without a designated path across the wide roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Across all legs of the intersection

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No pedestrian-specific signals are visible, forcing pedestrians to rely on vehicle signals which may not provide adequate crossing time.
hazards.location_in_image: At the corners of the intersection

hazards.name: Wide Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The multi-lane roadway requires a long unprotected crossing distance for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: The main roadway crossing

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style marked crosswalks on all legs of the intersection to define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing intervals and improve safety.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the corners to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The intersection features a marked zebra crosswalk and traffic signals but lacks dedicated pedestrian signal heads and continuous sidewalks. The roadway pavement is in poor condition with extensive cracking, and the lack of a complete sidewalk network forces pedestrians into the roadway.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Extensive alligator cracking and patching on the road surface create tripping hazards and may affect vehicle control.
hazards.location_in_image: Throughout the foreground and intersection area.

hazards.name: Discontinuous Sidewalk Network
hazards.description: The absence of sidewalks on multiple corners forces pedestrians to walk in the travel lane or on unpaved surfaces.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and right side of the intersection.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: While the intersection is signalized for vehicles, there are no visible pedestrian signal heads to indicate safe crossing times.
hazards.location_in_image: At the traffic light installation.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Completion
interventions.description: Construct a continuous sidewalk network on all sides of the intersection to provide a dedicated space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signal Installation
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers and push buttons to provide clear crossing guidance.

interventions.title: Pavement Rehabilitation
interventions.description: Resurface the roadway to eliminate cracks and provide a smooth, safe surface for all users.
